dialogues.title: Buying a jacket
dialogues.context: Bir mağazadasın, beğendiğin bir ceket var ama bedeninden emin değilsin.

lines.en: Hi there — can I help you find anything?
lines.tr: Merhaba, bir şey bulmanıza yardımcı olabilir miyim?
alternatives: Hello! Are you looking for anything in particular?

lines.en: I'm just looking, thanks.
alternatives: Just browsing, thanks.

lines.en: Actually — do you have this in a medium?
lines.tr: Aslında, bunun M bedeni var mı?
alternatives: Sorry, do you have a medium in this?

lines.en: Let me check the back. One second.
alternatives: I'll go have a look out back.

lines.en: Here you go. The fitting rooms are just past the shoes.
lines.tr: Buyurun. Deneme kabinleri ayakkabıların hemen ilerisinde.
alternatives: Found one. Changing rooms are over there.

lines.en: Thanks. Can I try this on?
alternatives: Great — is it okay if I try it on?

lines.en: Of course. How did it go?
alternatives: Please do. — Any good?

lines.en: It's a bit tight. Do you have the next size up?
lines.tr: Biraz dar geldi. Bir büyüğü var mı?
alternatives: A little tight — is there a large?

lines.en: That's the last one, I'm afraid. But it's on sale.
alternatives: Sorry, that was the last one — it is thirty percent off though.

lines.en: How much is it?
alternatives: What's the price with the discount?

lines.en: Forty-two, down from sixty.
alternatives: It's forty-two now, was sixty.

lines.en: I'll think about it. Thanks for your help.
alternatives: Let me think about it — thanks a lot.

dialogues.title: Haggling at the market
dialogues.context: Bir sokak pazarında el yapımı bir çanta beğendin. Fiyat yüksek — pazarlık edeceksin.

lines.en: Take a look, my friend. Handmade, all leather.
lines.tr: Bir bak dostum. El yapımı, tamamen deri.
alternatives: Have a look! Real leather, handmade.

lines.en: It's nice. How much is this one?
alternatives: I like it — what's the price?

lines.en: For you, seventy.
alternatives: Seventy, special price.

lines.en: That's a bit out of my price range.
alternatives: Hmm, that's more than I wanted to spend.

lines.en: How much were you thinking?
alternatives: What's your price then?

lines.en: Would you take forty for it?
alternatives: Could you do forty?

lines.en: Forty? No, no. Sixty, and that's a good deal.
lines.tr: Kırk mı? Yok yok. Altmış, üstelik iyi fiyat.
alternatives: Forty is too low. Sixty.

lines.en: Let's meet in the middle. Fifty.
alternatives: How about fifty and we're done?

lines.en: Fifty-five and it's yours.
alternatives: Make it fifty-five.

lines.en: Fifty. That's my final offer.
alternatives: I'll say fifty — final offer.

lines.en: Alright, alright. Fifty. You drive a hard bargain.
alternatives: Fine, fifty — you win.

lines.en: I'll take it. Do you take card?
alternatives: Perfect, I'll take it — card okay?

dialogues.title: Returning something
dialogues.context: Geçen hafta aldığın ayakkabı ayağını vurdu. Fişin yanında, iade etmeye gittin.

lines.en: Hi, how can I help?
alternatives: Hello! What can I do for you?

lines.en: I'd like to return this, please.
alternatives: I need to return these shoes.

lines.en: Sure. Is there something wrong with them?
alternatives: No problem. Any issue with them?

lines.en: They don't fit. They're too narrow.
alternatives: They just don't fit me.

lines.en: Do you have the receipt?
alternatives: Have you got your receipt with you?

lines.en: Yes, here it is. I bought them last Tuesday.
alternatives: Right here — I got them last week.

lines.en: Would you like a refund or an exchange?
alternatives: Refund or would you rather swap them?

lines.en: Do you have the next size up?
alternatives: Could I exchange them for a larger size?

lines.en: Let me check if we have it in stock.
alternatives: I'll see what we've got.

lines.en: We're sold out, sorry. More come in on Friday.
lines.tr: Stokta kalmamış, üzgünüm. Cuma yenisi geliyor.
alternatives: Sorry, none left — Friday we get more.

lines.en: Then I'll take the refund, please.
alternatives: A refund then, please.

lines.en: No problem. It'll go back on your card in a few days.
lines.tr: Sorun değil. Birkaç gün içinde kartınıza geçecek.
alternatives: Sure — back on your card within a few days.
